split_method: same fixed complete-cycle split as model comparison
optimization_strategy: Reduce tree count, maximum leaf nodes, or both while keeping random seed, minimum leaf size, and feature settings constant.
metrics: Proxy MAE/RMSE/R2 and exact serialized artifact file size. Latency and memory are reserved for roadmap phase 8.
interpretation: All scores compare predictions with an approximate proxy. The fixed test cycles informed model selection and are reused here for optimization, so these are exploratory trade-off results, not an independent final evaluation.
